meta.description: Expert discovery call strategist for B2B sales. Use when preparing for discovery calls, qualifying prospects, asking effective questions, identifying pain points, mapping stakeholders, or documenting findings. Covers SPIN selling, active listening, budget/timeline qualification, competition discovery, and CRM documentation. Use for sales qualification, needs analysis, and discovery call execution.
